issue.title: Setup - Project
issue.description:
## 🔧 Tech Story
As a developer,
I want to set the project structure and dependencies,
so that the codebase is organized and ready for feature development.

## 📋Acceptance Criteria
- [x] Create the file/folder structure for the project
- [x] Install main dependencies (Express, Svelte, Prisma, Typescript)
- [x] Install sub dependencies (validation, cryptographic, frontend styling/formating)

## 🔍 Tech Analysis
- Folder structure with /backend & /frontend at root
- Frontend: standard svelte structure
- Backend: 
   - /src in root containing routes, controllers, repositories, services, utils, helpers, middleware, validators
   - /tests containing tests and mock elements (mock repos, services)
   - /uploads for user uploaded content (images)
- Vitest for testing
- Zod for validation and input parsing
- Crypto for hashing / cryptographic
- Tailwind for frontend UI styling
- Prettier & eslint for formating and linting

logs.description: Set up the project structure, main & sub dependencies, and config files / other needed files (.env) for both the backend and frontend.
